proposedDirectQuizPairs.rationale: Actual complete sources and exact lexical object independently give the kilogram shortening; the Russian kilogram label fits. Keep the kilometre and prefix senses, not a kilogram-only rewrite.
Actual complete sources and exact lexical object independently give the kilometre shortening; the Russian kilometre label fits. Not inferred through the kilogram guard.
Actual exact キロ prefix sense explicitly means thousand; the accepted 千 caption is тысяча. Prefix status remains explicit, not a claim that bare キロ replaces 千 in ordinary counting.
Both exact primary objects/sources independently ask quantity. Actual Russian сколько overlaps even though price/amount and number/age select different constructions.
Exact objects independently give large quantity/many; actual Russian много fits. Preserve adjective versus noun/adverb syntax, not universal substitution.
Exact たくさん includes countable people; named modern Daijisen 大勢 explicitly means 多くの人. Both actual many labels can fit a people-quantity context. Not a generic amount-of-liquid sense for 大勢.
The complete source and exact たくさん object independently have enough; the actual accepted 結構 caption includes достаточно. Refusal context and register are retained, not automatic acceptance.
Named modern Daijisen 大勢 directly defines 多くの人 and the independently read 多い object means numerous. The broad actual много caption can fit that direct quantity sense, not inherited from たくさん.

Named modern Daijisen 大勢 directly denotes many people; the accepted generic человек;люди caption covers the human plural denotation. Submitted as a direct broad-label decision, not a claim that 人 itself asserts many.

The full 大勢 source teaches 大勢で as a large group. The actual accepted 組 caption has группа; the actually read Russian группа sense1 includes people together without requiring an institution or a small number. Review this direct broader-group label, not a source-English crowd token alone.

The full 大勢 source independently teaches a large group of people and the actual accepted 団体 caption includes группа. Actual Russian группа senses1/3 and the full 団体 body establish the broader group meaning; no claim that every crowd is a formal organisation.

Named modern Daijisen independently records written 大勢/たいせい sense3 as 大きな権勢、強い勢力. The actually read 権勢 definition concerns holding power; actual 力 caption сила;мощь and full abstract-power body fit. Do not claim modern frequency: the dictionary example is an older literary translation.

Direct evidence is written 大勢/たいせい sense3 権勢/勢力, not transitivity through 力. Actually read Russian влияние sense2 is власть в обществе, возможность воздействовать на ход событий; the actual 左右 caption includes влияние. This is a conservative bare-written-prompt caption guard, not teaching 大勢 as a suru verb or asserting current frequency.
Complete primary objects/sources independently cover all/everything in a contextual set; actual всё labels directly overlap. Keep people/items and syntax qualifications.

Complete sources/objects independently address or refer to everyone. Actual все labels overlap in the human scope; preserve respectful みなさん and casual/emphatic みんな, not universal register substitution.
Mandatory frozen source negative edge, also independently supported by both exact primary objects and named modern Daijisen 最も. Actual highest-degree labels overlap.
Mandatory frozen source negative edge; both full primary sources teach first/initial uses and actual первый captions overlap. First in sequence is not automatically best.

The actually read named modern Daijisen standalone 一/いち noun senses2/3 first/start and adverb いちばん、最も independently overlap with the actual new first/most label. Bound numeral/prefix examples alone are not the proof; no frequency assertion from the classical adverb quotation.
Named modern Daijisen standalone 一/いち noun senses2/3 explicitly first/beginning with 一から出直す. The actual 最初 caption начало;первый fits directly, not inferred through いちばん.

Named modern Daijisen standalone 一/いち explicitly has adverb 最も and noun highest/best; exact 最も highest-degree object independently confirms the overlap. Classical quotation does not establish modern frequency. Not inferred from the two いちばん edges.

Both complete primary sources and exact objects independently teach adverbial more; actual больше/более labels can fit that direct degree sense. Preserve comparative-particle standard-before-より and formal-from as separate uses.

sourceAdaptationDecisions: Translate every learner-facing section, label, meaning, example translation and source attribution. Preserve all Japanese examples/readings/forms, technical IDs/types/tags/levels and source qualifications.

Preserve measurement facts: kilo is1000prefix OR kilogram/kilometre by context, kilogram1000grams, metre100cm, kilometre1000metres; mass/length not volume; rare spellings stay rare and source language stays French. Metre/device spelling contrast is common usage, not an absolute ban.
Preserve both price/amount and how-many/how-old, kana spellings and respectful age-question context; not currency-specific and not a Russian-case/particle substitution table.

Preserveたくさんの versusな, enough/refusal pragmatics, 大勢 human plurality/mixednative-on reading and separateたいせい, 全部 contextual total, みんな people/things and respectful皆さん. No all/enough or people/group transitive clique.

Preserveいろいろ variety rather than necessary large quantity, 色々/々 spelling, いちばん first/degree/でcomparison group, もっとmore notmost/smallっ, よりstandard-before-particle plus adverb/formal-from, 最もdegree versus尤もreasonable, 最初beginning versus初めてfirst-ever.

No new images/scenes/strokes/mandatory kanji/grammar vocabulary contexts. Preserve full word kanji fields even where a kanji card is absent. Only unavailable optional navigation wrappers may be removed; substantive comparison prose remains.

All21 direct guard decisions remain unapproved author proposals. Rare/different-reading written-form guards do not assert modern frequency or expand the N5 syllabus; no true pair is inferred by transitivity.
